book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Jiso tɛɛŋ booŋ be ba kinchvu ba fwe
Gɛ̀ bee juu chimi, Jiso ja wu lɛme mbebe Mamasi wù Gɛnesalɛt le, gɛ̀ bee bamii tuŋ kiŋgaŋ bo faase wu bo yuge jɛ yi Nyo.
Wu ja wu yɛŋ baŋguh bafɛɛde june wu joo le, bamii ba gɛ̀ kɛme bo nyu bo bu wa yo bo chuge gii yiboo yi bíɛŋ.
Wu gɛɛŋ wu lee a ŋguh wumu le, nyu wu Samoŋ, wu jɛmɛ lɛ wu tooŋsɛ wu lee wù gɛɛŋ a joo shige. Wu tooŋsɛ, Jiso mo wu shii yo bamii nyu kwa wu yɛyi bo.
Wu gɛ̀ yɛyɛ wu mɛsɛ, wu mo wù jɛmɛ Samoŋ le lɛ,

content.text: “Tôoŋsɛ ŋguh wu lee wu gɛɛŋ fɛ joo njuume fo, bɛŋ noŋ gii yene bɛŋ koo bíɛŋ.”

content: Samoŋ chvuu lɛ, “Chiji kikwɛɛ, bee chi che lo we bee nooŋ gii bvu yuu, bee baaŋ fiɛɛ koo gɛ. Geenɛ, no jɛmɛ wo, nlé nôŋ gɛh lo.”
Bo gɛɛŋ bo noŋ, bo koo bíɛŋ yo wesee, bo doo bo bvuuse, gii yiboo goone ki yi sûumɛ.
Noo, bo ŋwalɛ bamii baboo ba kinchvu a ŋguh wumu le lɛ bo to bo fih bo. Bo to bo bvusɛ bíɛŋ yiyu yi yisɛ baŋguh baboo, baŋguh tu bo goone ki bo shiide a joo.
Samoŋ Bita yɛŋ fiɛɛ fì kooshi le, wu mo wu gɛɛŋ wu tuŋ anyuu wu ŋgvuumɛ a Jiso jii wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Kii wo Tada, ja fiuŋ fɛnɛ wo chinɛ mɛne, nle fiaŋ muh wù befe.”
Wu gɛ̀ jɛme noo, nje wu bɛ bamii be ba kinchvu gɛ̀ yɛŋ bíɛŋ yì bo gɛ̀ kolɛ le, ye kuufɛ bo.
Ye kuufɛ tɛ Jɛm bɛ Joŋ booŋ ba Jɛbɛdi ba gɛh bee tɛ a kinchvu ki Samoŋ le. Jiso jɛmɛ Samoŋ le lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ wo fâane gɛ. Kɛge mɛɛse gɛɛne fwe, wo lé wo koode wa nyume bamii.”

content: Lɛ bo yu noo, bo mo bo bvusɛ baŋguh baboo kwa, bo chinɛ mwɛɛ munchii le bo mo bo bii Jiso le.
Jiso fɛ muh wu goŋ yì baaŋ

Lɛ to nyume kife kimi le, Jiso nyu a kinlaantɛŋ kimi le, muh mu nyu yo goŋ yì baaŋ nyu yi ji wu. Muh wuyu yɛŋ Jiso le, wu to wu gwe a wu jii, wu lɛgɛ wu wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Tada, wo taŋlo wo fɛ mɛ n'yuu, fɛ wo nɛ koŋe lo.”
Jiso mo wu nɛjɛ kibo wu kuŋ wu le wu jɛmɛ lɛ,
Kimimia, goŋ yì baaŋ yiyu mo yi chinɛ wu le.
Jiso chiisɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo yɛ̂ne keefɛ wo sɛ̂ɛŋ muh le gɛ. Geenɛ, wo gɛ̂ɛŋ wo chûnyɛ ye yo chiji kintanyɛ le, wo mo wo nyâ nyaa yì Musɛ gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ muh kɛmɛ ki wu nyâ ki wu chûnyɛ bamii le lɛ wu le wu tɛmɛ yi goŋ yinɛ le wu mo wu yuude.”

content: No Jiso gɛ̀ chiisɛ muh wɛɛ le noo, saaka wu kune Jiso ka wu jiɛnyɛ wu fe lo, binchvu bì baaŋ baaŋ bi bamii bi baanyi bi too ki bi yû n'yɛyɛ we, bɛ ki wu fɛ̂de binchɛŋ biboo.
Geenɛ, Jiso to wu chinɛ bo le wu gɛɛŋ wu buune nchvuuŋ.
Jiso fɛ muh wu kwe kimbe kimimia

Gɛ̀ bee juu chimi Jiso yɛyi bamii, bvuŋga bvu Tada nyu yi ye ye le lɛ wu fɛde binchɛŋ yu. Bafalashii bɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo shii fo, ba gɛ̀ bu bantɛ bachii ba Galalee le, mo bimbe bi Judia bɛ Yɛlusalɛm le.
Fi kooshɛ lɛ bamii bamu gɛ̀ bee bo ja bo too bo shumɛ muh yi bvuko le, wù nyu wu kwe kimbe kimimia. Bo gɛ̀ mone ki bo to bo lee bɛ wu yeh, bo giŋsɛ a Jiso fwe.
Geenɛ, bo gɛ̀ baaŋ kɛmɛ gɛ̀ je ki bo lee bɛ wu gɛ, nje bamii gɛ̀ fasɛ baaŋ. Bo mo bo bɛɛŋ nyu a yeh we, bo chiɛɛ kiyɛ, bo shiishɛ muh wuyu a bamii ntɛnɛɛ, a Jiso fwe, a fiɛɛ fì wu gɛ̀ gime yo le.
No Jiso gɛ̀ yɛŋ lɛ bamii baa le bo gɛɛ muntele muboo ye ye le, wu mo wu jɛmɛ muh wuyu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsaa yaŋ, nle nlɛɛshɛ wa bimbefɛ biuŋ.”

content: Bamii ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo bɛ kinchvu ki Bafalashii baa, mo bo kɛ bo fiɛge bo duu lɛ, “Wunɛ le yɛɛŋ wù jode kijusɛ ki Nyo? Le yɛɛŋ wù taŋlo wu lɛɛshɛ bimbefɛ, fuge Nyo sɛŋ?”
Jiso kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì bo shuŋshi, wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kɛme kfuu chi banɛ baŋkwajɛ a muntele mwɛna le nɛ nje la?
Fi chige le fi la, ki njɛmɛ lɛ nle nlɛɛshɛ wa bimbefɛ bi muh wunɛ noo, lɛ wu ja we wu jiɛnyi le?
Geenɛ, nlé ŋgê bɛŋ kɛ̂ɛ lɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh kɛme bvuŋga fɛkuu fɛnɛ ki wu lɛ̂ɛshɛ bimbefɛ.”

content: Wu mo wu jɛmɛ muh wu gɛ̀ kwe wa kimbe kimimia wuyu le lɛ,

content.text: “Jɛme mɛ wo le, jâ we, wo jô bvuko bwuŋ wo gɛ̂ɛne a wo yeh.”

content: Kimimia, wu mo wu ja we wu lɛɛŋ a bamii jii, wu mo wu jo fiɛɛ fì wu gɛ̀ gime yu wege wu mo wu ja wu gɛɛne fɛ wu kfuuŋ, wu tume maŋkuŋ ma Nyo.
Bamii yɛŋ noo, jwe yuŋ bo bo kɛmɛ kiŋgha, bo tume maŋkuŋ ma Nyo bo duu lɛ, “Bee le be yɛŋ biŋgha bi mwɛɛ le abɛŋ.”
Jiso tɛɛŋ Lɛwe
Jiso gɛ̀ ja wu bu fo wu jiɛnyi. Wu doo wu gɛɛne, wu yɛŋ muh mu wu gɛ̀ koode ŋwa le ba tɛŋe lɛ Lɛwe, wu gɛ̀ shii kijusɛ ke ki lɛme le. Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,
Lɛwe chinɛ mwɛɛ munchii le, wu ja we wu mo wu bii Jiso le.
Noo, Lɛwe mo wu ge ŋka wu baaŋ a wu yeh ki wu ŋgvûuŋ Jiso. Bamii ba gɛ̀ koode ŋwa ŋɛɛne lo fo, mo bamii bamu ba bɛ bo gɛ̀ jii mwɛɛ.

Bafalashii bɛ bamii baboo ba kinchvu ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo bo kɛ bo shuŋshi, bo biide booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso le lɛ, “Le nje la fì bɛŋ jii bɛŋ muu mwɛɛ bɛ bamii ba koode ŋwa mo bamii bamu ba befe?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ bamii ba tɛɛme to bo goone muh wu nche gɛ. To goone nyu bamii ba chɛne.
Gɛ nto ki ntɛɛŋ bamii ba chaaŋ gɛ. Nto ki ntɛɛŋ nyume bamii ba befe lɛ bo kusɛ muntele muboo.”

content: Bo biih Jiso kune mbaŋ mwɛɛ munjile
Bo gɛ̀ ja bo ghaayi Jiso lɛ, “Booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Joŋ ja bo banɛ mwɛɛ munjile bo buune lɛfolɛfo, nyu gɛh no ba Bafalashii gee, geenɛ buŋ booŋ jii lo fiboo bo ka muu mwɛɛ.”
Jiso ma jɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Taŋlo muh tɛɛŋ bamii fɛ bvuguu le bo to bo banɛ mwɛɛ munjile chiji bvuguu nyu bɛ bo?
Geenɛ, kife lé ki tô ki kôjɛ ki ba lé ba fî chiji bvuguu wuyu, a bo le, le a bvu wu bo lé bo kɛ̂ bo bânɛ mwɛɛ munjile kife kɛɛ le.”

content: Wu ka wu ma ŋgaŋ wumu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ muh taŋlo wu saayɛ nju yifiɛŋ wu chvuushɛ yì kege yu gɛ. Wu ge lo noo, tu wu le wu chɛŋɛ bɛ nju yifiɛŋ yɛɛ. Gɛ taŋlo fichaŋa fì fɛŋ fiɛɛ gɛɛŋ yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ bɛ nju yì kege yɛɛ gɛ.
Gɛ taŋlo muh tɛ jo mbvuuŋ ma manfɛŋ, wu gɛɛ a kolo wu mbvuuŋ wù juŋ wa le gɛ. Wu ge lo noo, mbvuuŋ ma manfɛŋ maa ge mo koo, mo saayɛ lo kolo wù kege wɛɛ, mbvuuŋ bɛ kolo mu mo mu lɛsɛ achiji.
Fi kooji le lɛ, ba kɛme ki ba gɛɛ mbvuuŋ ma manfɛŋ nyu a kolo wù fwɛŋ le.
Bɛŋ kee tɛ lɛ gɛ muh nyu yu wù muu mbvuuŋ ma koo wa wù ka wu koŋe ma manfɛŋ gɛ. Wu to wu duu gɛh lɛ mà koo wa maa le mà joŋe.”
